incident.title: Payments latency after replica scale-out
incident.symptoms: Checkout requests time out. Database connection pool is exhausted after scaling from 4 to 12 replicas.
incident.logs:
ERROR QueuePool limit of size 20 overflow 10 reached
FATAL: too many clients already
checkout p99=8420ms active_connections=198/200
incident.context: Synthetic scenario. A recent deployment increased replica count.

records.root_cause: Replica scale-out multiplied per-process connection limits beyond database capacity.

attempts.explanation: Connection errors returned within two minutes because pool sizing was unchanged.
Reduced per-replica pool size in a controlled test; total connections stayed below database capacity.

records.lessons: Budget database connections across replicas, workers, and background jobs.

incident.title: Gateway returns 502 for catalog requests
incident.symptoms: Gateway 502 errors started after deployment. Upstream connection refused on port 8080.
incident.logs:
upstream connect() failed (111: Connection refused)
GET /catalog 502 upstream=10.0.1.24:8080
incident.context: Synthetic scenario. Container health is green.

records.root_cause: Gateway upstream port remained 8080 while the new container listened on 8000.

attempts.explanation: Connection refused persisted because no process listened on the configured upstream port.
Staging validation reached the healthy container on port 8000.

records.lessons: Validate upstream port mappings and readiness through the actual gateway route.

incident.title: Session writes fail during traffic peak
incident.symptoms: Redis memory is at maxmemory. OOM errors prevent session writes and users are signed out.
incident.logs:
OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory
used_memory=2147483648 evicted_keys=0
incident.context: Synthetic scenario. A bulk import added long-lived cache keys.

records.root_cause: Redis noeviction policy and unbounded import keys exhausted available cache memory.

attempts.explanation: The data set returned at startup and memory pressure remained.

attempts.action: Bound import key TTLs and validate eviction policy
attempts.explanation: A staging test of bounded TTLs and an approved eviction policy restored writes.

records.lessons: Measure key growth and verify eviction behavior before increasing capacity.
